flags.item: Betting lines, prices and totals, every season
flags.finding: No official NFL page publishes historical closing lines. Every line-based number here and in other sessions' strategy tables rests on a community dataset.
flags.suggested_action: Pick one line source with capture times and licence terms, or accept that line-based results stay unverified.

flags.finding: Only 2021 to 2026 were compared with the official standings (1,344 of 1,344 fields match). The earlier 22 seasons were not compared.
flags.suggested_action: Repeat the audit for the remaining seasons before trusting long backtests that start in 1999 or 2005.

flags.finding: The official division standings page, as fetched, shows the eight four-team groups but not their names. Conference and grouping are confirmed for all 32 clubs; the name labels are not confirmed by this session.
flags.suggested_action: For data/teams.csv: confirm the names on a page that prints them, then mark the column verified.

flags.item: Division-game count on the live Validation and Correlation page
flags.finding: Published: 52 of 136 games were division games, correlation with total points -0.1297. Using the official groupings: 42 games, correlation -0.1048. The 10 extra games are all AFC West against NFC West: the code compares the word West and ignores the conference.
flags.suggested_action: In analysis/correlations.py compare conference and division together, then regenerate correlations.json and pages/analysis.html. Any rule that uses this division flag needs re-running.

flags.item: Two closing-line files from the same maintainer disagree
flags.finding: Across 3,368 games in both files, the spread is identical in 67.31% and the total in 61.7%. There is no single closing line. Strategy win rates move by up to 0.75 points when the other file is used.
flags.suggested_action: Record which book and which timestamp each line comes from.

flags.item: Every bet graded at an assumed price of -110
flags.finding: The dataset holds actual prices for most games since 2006. Using them changes return on investment by 0.34 to 2.94 percentage points. No verdict changes.
flags.suggested_action: Grade at the recorded price where one exists and say which rows used the assumption.
flags.source_label: Their strategies file at the commit checked

flags.item: 18 published numbers could not be tested here
flags.finding: The own-line model, its error figures and four strategies (S01, S02, S03, S12) need play-by-play and injury files that this sandbox cannot download.
flags.suggested_action: Run the replication script where those files are reachable, for example in the branch's own workflow.
flags.source_label: Their lines file at the commit checked

flags.item: Strategy pairs that are the same bet
flags.finding: 28 replicated strategy pairs have a correlation of exactly 1.0 or -1.0 on the games they share (for example S04 with S06 on 207 games). They are one bet counted under two names, or the two sides of one bet. The owner's gate G8 fails them, which is the correct outcome.
flags.suggested_action: Merge or drop duplicates before counting how many strategies were tried.
flags.source_label: Their strategies file at the commit checked

flags.finding: data/model/errors.json still shows a failure in the strategy stage (KeyError 'te') stamped 04:34:07 UTC, although later builds wrote a complete leaderboard. The file is not cleared on success.
flags.suggested_action: Rewrite the error file on every run so an old failure is not mistaken for a current one.
flags.source_label: Their errors file at the commit checked

flags.item: Schedule link that changes meaning each week
flags.finding: Source links of the form nfl.com/schedules/2026/REG10 redirect to the current week's schedule. Today that is Week 10, next week it will not be.

flags.item: Three NFL Football Operations addresses return 404
flags.finding: operations.nfl.com/the-rules/, /gameday/ and /gameday/nfl-schedule/ each returned the site's 404 page when fetched by this session. They are no longer cited on main (fixed after session 15e79a53 reported them).
flags.suggested_action: No action needed. Kept for the record.

flags.item: Tasks marked done with no files on GitHub
flags.finding: 946c1684: 2 files on the branch, last commit 04:29:32 UTC; 87deb7ab: 2 files on the branch, last commit 04:36:41 UTC. Their boards list data, scripts and pages as done, but none of those files has been pushed.
flags.suggested_action: Treat these claims as open. Under the 60-minute rule they can be taken over if no commit follows.

flags.item: Unmerged branches rewrite files that are already live
flags.finding: 10 files on main are modified by at least one unmerged branch; 1 of them by more than one (README.md). Whichever merges second will conflict or overwrite.
flags.suggested_action: One integration owner should merge these in sequence and re-check the pages after each merge.

flags.item: The coordination file is rewritten wholesale by each session
flags.finding: Several sessions replaced COORDINATION.md instead of appending to it, and at least four claim the final integration task. This session hit a merge conflict on that file at every sync (five times). It resolves them by keeping main's version unchanged and re-appending its own block.
flags.suggested_action: Give each session its own section or file so that merges do not collide.

flags.finding: NFL.com uses LA for the Rams (and AZ for Arizona). The values in the row are correct; only the code differs from the official one.
flags.suggested_action: Use the official club code or document the mapping.

flags.item: 2022: Buffalo and Cincinnati have 16 games, not 17
flags.finding: The dataset and the official 2022 standings agree on this. The reason was not looked up in an official source in this session, so none is stated.
flags.suggested_action: No change to the numbers. Models that assume 17 games per team must allow for it.

flags.item: Seven 2026 games are marked neutral-site in the dataset
flags.finding: Home and road records still match the official standings for all 32 clubs, so the official page counts a designated home team in these games. Home-field estimates should treat them separately.
flags.suggested_action: Exclude or flag neutral-site games when estimating home advantage.
